newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee Land Q4 investment income rises.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee Land Q4 investment income rises.

text.p: Milwaukee Land Co said Thursday its net investment income reached $90,820 in the fourth quarter ended December 31, up from $9,345 in the corresponding period one year ago.
The company said net realized gains on sale of investments in the fourth quarter totaled $11,521 versus $30,979 in the fourth quarter of 1995.

For the year ended December 31, net investment income totaled $125,510, up from $122,543 a year ago, Milwaukee Land said. Net realized gains on sale of investments for the year reached $57,132 versus a loss of $52,728 in the same period in 1995. Net assets were $17.6 million, down from $19.0 million.
Milwaukee Land is a closed-end investment company.
